restored_after_fault: Sense restored -> remains OFF (or FORCE if configured) until host re-arms
verdict: PASS (with protection); FAIL without protection (rail=12V, DUT overvoltage)

detection_method: Latched FAULT_SENSE_OPEN persists; restoration detected on next switched test before next OUTPUT ON

notes: Auto-resume would risk re-chatter; explicit re-arm is required (ARCH §3.2).
